description: The three saved WordPress listings establish concrete scope mismatches: one explicitly rejects AI-dependent development, one requires accessibility delivery not demonstrated here, and one requires a substantial live-system migration. Stop preparation for these listings and preserve the findings. Five unclassified feedback sources leave inbound demand unknown; funds and verified revenue remain zero. These findings do not reject the wider WordPress market. Reconsider with a permitted, bounded buyer task supported by demonstrated delivery capability.
